actions.name: Reel In
actions.description: As a reaction when this weapon hits, the mech pulls the target up to 30 ft. toward itself unless the target succeeds at a Reflex save (DC 12 + ½ the mech's tier). This movement doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. Creatures two or more sizes larger than the mech aren't affected.

description.value:
